sections.heading: How It Works
sections.text: Our decision-making process is informed by comprehensive empirical data. We don't just assign a dog; we carefully craft a team designed for mutual success and safety.
items: 1. Application & Assessment [clipboard-check] — Veterans complete a thorough application detailing their needs, lifestyle, and environment. We review this to ensure our program is the right fit.
2. Precision Matching [users] — Using proven empirical strategies, we match the veteran with a canine whose temperament, drive, and skills perfectly complement the veteran's needs.
3. Rigorous Training [dog] — Our dogs undergo extensive training tailored to the specific disabilities of their matched veteran, learning precise commands and behaviors.
4. Team Placement [graduation-cap] — The veteran and dog train together as a unit. Upon successful completion, they graduate as a certified Heartland K9s team.

sections.heading: The BarKode Program
sections.text: A vital safety net dedicated to the memory of Derron and his service dog, Rosie.
sections.layout: h-[70vh] min-h-500 bg-cover; overlays bg-primary/80 multiply + .hero-gradient; centered; h1 up to text-7xl

sections.heading: Dedicated to Derron & Rosie
sections.text: The BarKode program was born out of profound necessity and heartbreaking loss. It is dedicated to Derron, a veteran, and his beloved service dog, Rosie. Their story highlighted a critical gap in the safety protocols for working dog teams when emergencies strike. || When a veteran experiences a medical emergency in public, first responders need immediate access to vital information—not only about the veteran, but also about the service dog standing guard. Without clear identification and instructions, dogs can be separated from their handlers or misunderstood in chaotic situations. BarKode ensures this never happens again.
sections.layout: py-20 max-w-4xl; bg-primary/5 rounded-2xl p-8/12 border; heading centered, paragraphs text-left; crimson 48px heart-pulse icon

sections.heading: How BarKode Protects
items: Instant Identification [qr-code] — Every Heartland K9 wears a specialized patch featuring a unique BarKode. First responders can instantly identify the dog as a certified, trained service animal.
Emergency Contacts [phone-call] — Scanning the BarKode provides immediate access to emergency contact protocols, ensuring the dog's well-being is managed safely while the veteran receives care.
Legitimacy & Trust [shield-check] — In an era of fraudulent service dogs, BarKode serves as undeniable proof of the team's rigorous training and certification through Heartland K9s.

Contact form is purely simulated (setTimeout 1000ms, toast, reset) with no name attributes on inputs. Live-site cross-checks used /live/pages.json and /live/home.html; key discrepancies: invented 5 Questions, missing physical address, 'nationwide' and 'Mon–Fri' not on live site, all four testimonials are placeholders.
